preconditions.description: The number of fields n must be between 1 and 60000.
The number of die faces m must be between 4 and 100000.
The number of turns k must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f_i <= n for f_i in f)
preconditions.description: Each field transition value f_i must be a valid field index between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= p_j < 998244353 for p_j in p)
preconditions.description: Each die face probability p_j must be a non-negative integer less than 998244353.
The sum of the probabilities of the die faces must be congruent to 1 modulo 998244353.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n lines, one for each field.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) < 998244353 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line must be a valid probability value between 0 and 998244352.
The sum of the output probabilities must be congruent to 1 modulo 998244353.
